newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada bishop jailed for raping two teens in 1965.
newsitem.headline: Canada bishop jailed for raping two teens in 1965.

text.p: A 68-year-old Catholic bishop was sentenced on Friday to two and a half years in prison for rape and indecent assault on two teenaged native women more than 30 years ago.
Justic Wally Opal called the crimes committed by Bishop Hubert O'Connor "highly offensive" and denied a request by his lawyers for a conditional sentence to be served in the community.

O'Connor was principal of a native residential school when he committed the offences in 1965 against the two teens. He was the highest-ranking member of the Roman Catholic church in Canada to be convicted of such offences.
The judge said in imposing the sentence he had considered the lapse of time and the fact that the bishop was in ill health and was not a threat to the community.
O'Connor read a brief statement before sentencing: "I feel sorry for all the parties involved. If I had not broken my vow of chastity, I would not be here today. I have paid a very heavy price."
